certified_intervals.construction: 4 Cartesian patches over certified coordinate intervals; f3 = 6 - A(f1) - A(f2), A(x) = x(1+sin(3*pi*x)); the high interval is open at b because A(a)=A(b) and the smaller coordinate a dominates b
certified_intervals.pareto_coordinate_set: [0,a] U (b,c] (endpoint b excluded: fold tie A(a)=A(b))

module_versions.deap_nsga3_note: DEAP 1.4 ships no NSGA-III algorithm. pymoo NSGA3 is the algorithm-level oracle; DEAP supplies component-level oracles (sortNondominated, exact 3D hypervolume, cxSimulatedBinaryBounded, mutPolynomialBounded).
